d:
SPECIAL: pakur ki malaphari panchayat men buniyadi suvidhaon ka tota, sarkari yojnaon ka labh dilane men nakam raha jila prashasan
Jila mukhyalay se mahaj 5 se 6 KM dur sthit aadivasi bahul panchayat malaphari men rah rahe log samasyaon ke chalte pareshan hai. vahan rah rahe graminon ka aarop hai ki jila prashasan ne vastavik vikas ko dharatal par utarne ke lie ab tak ko ee koshish tak nahin ki hai. lihaja is panchayat ke mushar tola, baghajoli, mayurkola, chandpur aur malaphari ganv men rahne vale log samasyaon ke jal men phanskar rah gae hain.
